_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Use when working with Printify — the print-on-demand REST API, catalog model (blueprints, print providers, variants,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Create a Printify product from a blueprint + print provider + variant set and publish it to a connected Shopify store"
cases.context: The agent has access to the printify skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is printify the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes printify as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against webhook-integration, api-design, shopify
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the printify workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore printify
Does not route to webhook-integration, api-design, shopify when the printify scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
